issuer: the starosta (district head) of the place of residence, through the starostwo powiatowe
note: gov.pl's service pages (read 2026-10-30; the licence page last updated 7 April 2026): the licence is applied for at the starostwo powiatowe of the place of residence and costs 100 zł to issue (the course, the medical and the state exam aren't held). The categories page gives category B from 17, with the holder driving only within Poland until 18: a licence with no such limit is kept from 18. The term (15 years under the Act on vehicle drivers) isn't on the pages read, and the Sejm's legal database (isap.sejm.gov.pl) refused the request behind an Incapsula check, so it is null. Poland's identity card is a municipality's, not held here; no exchange list was read (EU and EEA licences are recognised without exchange).
